summary.label: § 01 — Summary
summary.text: Full-stack engineer with hands-on experience across the complete development lifecycle. Proficient in building {production} web applications, designing {scalable} backend systems, and managing the {cloud} they run on. Focused on delivering reliable, maintainable software that solves real problems for real businesses.

items.title: Software Engineer · DevOps · AI Automation Lead
bullets: Leading full-stack development of BarriereHilfe, a 3-tier WCAG-compliant accessibility platform, alongside kodschul.de and the Nextise corporate website — modernizing legacy systems with Next.js SSR and edge caching to sharpen core web vitals and SEO.

Own the production Kubernetes cluster on DigitalOcean end-to-end — cluster scaling, migrating multiple production sites off a failing droplet, and resolving the DNS propagation, SSL validation, and persistent-volume issues along the way.
Author every GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline across the team's projects, cutting deployment time by 40% through custom workflows and infrastructure-as-code.
Lead development of Kontakly Databee, an AI-driven B2B lead-generation pipeline for the DACH market — site-specific scrapers, LinkedIn enrichment, and a Gemini AI decision-maker finder.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Built the We Xperience public website in Next.js, integrating PrestaShop for product management via a BFF pattern, with full EN/FR internationalization.
Developed backend APIs and Angular/Laravel frontend integrations for the Finance and Call Center modules of TargetDesk, the company's multi-tenant CRM, accounting, and call-center platform.

Delivered client work for Xalimart Group: TargetPoint-Signature, a Laravel + Next.js email-signature management SaaS with onboarding, domain verification, and cascade template assignment, plus their multilingual corporate website and CMS in Next.js and Payload CMS, deployed on a bare-metal Linux VPS.

items.title: Founder & Lead Developer
bullets: Architected and deployed high-performance platforms including nadscam.org, csb-amasia.com, and ramanasa.com through strategic partnerships with MTN Business and Canal+ distributors.
Designed and launched thrift-plug.com, a full-scale e-commerce store built with Next.js and PayloadCMS, featuring custom AI integration for automated and accurate product descriptions.
Configured and managed Hostinger VPS environments with optimized Nginx configurations and custom GitHub CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
Led digital growth for client brands, including full setup and active management of Google My Business profiles to drive local engagement and visibility.

items.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed high-throughput API services using Golang for a large-scale CRM system, optimizing data retrieval speeds.
Integrated Python-based LLM analysis tools into web dashboards to provide actionable real estate market insights.
Collaborated on optimized 2D interactive simulations using Unity for educational and training purposes.
